messages:
Asha - CSM: Heads up — HelioLabs flagged at week 2 of onboarding, usage stalled after initial ingest. Renewal in ~28d. Risk = HIGH (possible downgrade to Starter). Proposing a mini-bootcamp save: 3 enablement touches + milestone usage credit + quick feedback capture. Thoughts?

churn-bot: Automated alert: HelioLabs (acct HL-214) churn score 0.78 — triggers: low API calls, no evals run. Details: https://redwood.internal/alerts/HL-214

Ben - CS Ops: +1 to bootcamp. Quick ask — can we scope to 2 technical sessions + 1 exec check-in so AM/CS effort stays small? target total <4h.

Carlos - AM: I can run the exec check-in. Asha, what are the 3 success outcomes we want them to hit so I can steer the convo?

Asha - CSM: Priority outcomes: 1) successful model rollout to staging, 2) run eval set and see baseline metrics, 3) set autoscaling policy (predictable spend). I'll DM the account specifics.

Emma - Enablement: Enablement can spin up a 45m workshop + one-pager playbook. Draft template below.

```
Workshop agenda:
- 0-10m: goals + alignment
- 10-25m: config walkthrough (ingest, model mapping, routing)
- 25-40m: run eval + interpret results (quality vs cost)
- 40-45m: actions, owners, next steps

Email template:
Subject: Quick enablement workshop — HelioLabs + Redwood
Hi <FirstName>,
We want to run a short workshop to unblock staging rollout and benchmarking. Proposed times: <options>. Agenda attached.
Best,
Asha
```

Carlos - AM: For milestone credit — recommend offering a one-time $2k usage credit tied to hitting the staging rollout + eval run within 21 days. Finance ok?

Nikhil - RevOps: Finance: approve up to $2k usage-credit for midmarket saves if CS provides LOE and success criteria. Need ticket in Salesforce with expected dates.

Asha - CSM: LOE estimate: 3 sessions (AM + CSM) ~3.5h total + enablement prep 2h. Agree to LOE and will open SF ticket.

Ben - CS Ops: I'll add a 5-question feedback form (post-workshop) to capture friction + feature asks. Will share link after session. Also recommend weekly 30m check-ins until renewal.

Asha - CSM: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the sessions. Carlos, can you hold an exec slot for the check-in next Wed?

Carlos - AM: Penciled in next Wed 11a PT.

Asha - CSM: Capturing runbook checklist below (quick copyable):

```
Bootcamp-Intercept Runbook (HelioLabs)
- Trigger: churn-bot score >=0.7 and onboarding idle >7d
- Owner: Asha (CSM) / Carlos (AM) / Emma (Enablement)
- Actions:
  1) Open SF ticket with LOE, credit amount, success criteria (Asha)
  2) Schedule 2x technical workshops + 1x exec check-in (Asha/Carlos)
  3) Enablement creates one-pager + workshop link (Emma)
  4) Apply usage credit on success (RevOps)
  5) Post-workshop feedback form + follow-up cadence (Ben)
- Success criteria: staging rollout + eval results submitted + autoscaling configured
- Timeline: sessions within 14 days, eval run within 21 days, monitor 7-day usage bump
```

Ben - CS Ops: I'll attach the feedback form to the SF ticket and set reminders.

Asha - CSM: Marking this playbook as 'bootcamp-intercept-v1' and tagging for weekly save-report. Will update the account thread after session 1. Thanks all.

churn-bot: Note added to HL-214: playbook applied = bootcamp-intercept-v1.
